name: Flashcards & Spaced Review
description: Custom Q&A decks with a transparent interval ladder: first pass 1 day, then 3/7/14/30 days; CSV import, undo and backups
help: Build decks by typing questions/answers with tags, or batch import UTF-8 CSV (columns question,answer,deck,tags; tags separated by semicolons; quotes escaped).
The question shows first; grade buttons appear only after you flip. Skipping is allowed — nothing is forced and unshown cards never count as reviewed.

The ladder is simple and public: first pass schedules 1 day, consecutive passes go 3/7/14/30 days and stay at 30; forgetting resets to 1 day. Dates follow the actual grading day — no fictional catch-up reviews.
Undo reverts the latest grade (stage, due date and log); editing a card never resets progress; grading twice cannot log twice.
Pause cards per deck (history kept); backups are progress-complete JSON with a conflict preview before restore. All data stays local; scheduling runs in Rust.
